capabilities: Chart tag counts over time, one line per tag
Chart inbound link counts per note in a links mode
Toggle, filter and reset which tags or notes are shown
Choose the date source: created, modified, or a frontmatter property
Group nested tags under their top-level tag or chart them separately
extras: Works offline and reads only vault notes. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. The history is reconstructed from note dates at open time, so it cannot know when a tag was actually added, and deleted notes are not counted.
motivation: The author wanted Vault Size History's vault-growth chart applied to tags instead of file counts.
problem: Obsidian shows current tag and link counts but no way to see how those counts changed over the vault's history.

relations.evidence: It is inspired by Vault Size History by Technerium.
The chart is drawn with Apache ECharts, which is bundled into the plugin

summary: Chart plugin that draws one line per tag showing how many notes carry it over time, with an optional mode for inbound link counts per note.
